metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over Mayfield, Kentucky higher in November 2021 than on December 10-12, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need nighttime brightness data. VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB) from Suomi NPP or NOAA-20 would be appropriate. Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG" or "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" for monthly composites. For November 2021, I'll use the monthly composite. Masking strategy: VIIRS DNB data typically needs cloud masking. The monthly composites often have cloud-free flags. I'll use the 'cf_cvg' band or quality flags. 3. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
mayfield = ee.Geometry.Point([-88.6367, 36.7417]).buffer(5000)  # 5km buffer around Mayfield

# November 2021 (monthly composite)
nov_start = '2021-11-01'
nov_end = '2021-11-30'

# December 10-12, 2021 (daily data)
dec_start = '2021-12-10'
dec_end = '2021-12-12'

# 2. Data Acquisition - November monthly composite
nov_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \
    .filterDate(nov_start, nov_end) \
    .filterBounds(mayfield)

# Check November data
if nov_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No November 2021 data found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    nov_img = nov_col.first()
    
    # December daily data
    dec_col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \
        .filterDate(dec_start, dec_end) \
        .filterBounds(mayfield)
    
    if dec_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No December 10-12, 2021 data found.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # Process November data
        nov_rad = nov_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=mayfield,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
        
        nov_count = nov_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=mayfield,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
        
        # Process December data (average of 3 days)
        dec_mean = dec_col.mean()
        dec_rad = dec_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=mayfield,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
        
        dec_count = dec_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=mayfield,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
        
        # Check for valid pixels
        if nov_count == 0 or dec_count == 0:
            print(f"Nov pixels: {nov_count}, Dec pixels: {dec_count}")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        elif nov_rad is None or dec_rad is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Nov radiance: {nov_rad:.4f} (pixels: {nov_count})")
            print(f"Dec radiance: {dec_rad:.4f} (pixels: {dec_count})")
            
            # Compare values
            if nov_rad > dec_rad:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
